description: List all connected social media channels (X/Twitter, Instagram, LinkedIn, Facebook, TikTok, etc.). Returns channel ID, platform, account name, and token status, plus a `capabilities` object saying whether the caller may create, publish or approve posts. Check that before attempting a write rather than discovering the permission from a 403. Use this when the user wants to see which social accounts are connected.

active.description: Filter by active status. Defaults to true (only active channels).

name: list_channels

capabilities.description: Whether the caller may create, publish or approve posts.

title: List channels
